pages.title: An Authentic Crown
pages.text: Only the crown dropped by Apep carries an authority tag. Copies from Creative, /give, or any other source can be equipped, but show no authority details, grant no power, and cannot start crown-bound rites.

pages.title: Random Authority
pages.text: An authentic crown selects one authority when dropped: physical, projectile, explosion, fire, lava, lightning, magic, wither, dragon breath, sonic, freeze, drowning, suffocation, cramming, falling, void, world border, thorns, or true damage.

pages.title: Charm Effect
pages.text: When equipped in a charm slot, attacks against hostile entities have a 25% chance to deal extra authority damage equal to 25% of your current health at that moment.$(br2)Hold Shift on the crown to read the selected damage type's exact rules.

pages.title: Crystals for Revival
pages.text: After the island is destroyed, its ten crystal towers remain. Place one Heka Radiant Crystal on every tower base, ten in total. The initiator must wear an authentic, empowered crown.

pages.title: Rite of Ten Towers
pages.text: Once all ten crystals are present, their beams form a ring for three seconds, then aim above the island center. A ten-second charge rebuilds the destroyed floor.$(br2)The final burst summons Stage I Apep, immediately using the same combat logic as the original spawn.

pages.title: Interruption Conditions
pages.text: The rite cannot begin while Apep lives or the death blast is active, with an unpowered or unequipped crown, or while any tower lacks a crystal.$(br2)If a required crystal becomes invalid during the rite, the revival is cancelled.
